description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller 'QrController' that manages QR code-based login sessions. It provides endpoints for creating sessions, polling session status, fetching authentication options, verifying assertions, retrieving result tokens, and displaying a simple HTML page for debugging or demo purposes.

classes.name: QrController
classes.description: A REST controller managing QR code-based login sessions, providing endpoints for session creation, status polling, authentication options, verification, token retrieval, and a simple HTML display.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new QR session for login polling.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns current session status, including whether it has been approved, rejected, or scanned.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Fetches WebAuthn authentication options for the session and user.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies the user's WebAuthn assertion and approves the session.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Retrieves the JWT token after a session has been approved.

methods.name: sessionHtml
methods.description: Provides a simple HTML page indicating that the QR session exists, for debugging or demonstration.
